items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Waltzing Matilda' in the context of the bar's atmosphere or perhaps a song title, but does not describe a personal relationship with a person named Matilda.

ctx.x: And he liked to have women around, so the was always full of women that had nowhere to go in life,

just Waltzing Matilda. So they'd be sitting around and he'd probably make sure they'd get a bunk or get fed, and wait for a live one. A live one would come in and sit down at that bar. That was the end, if he had any money, because the parade would start.

I'd be playing behind the bar and the parade started. First one girl would walk behind the bar, maybe just rub it a little, and he'd pay no attention. Guy's drinking his Irish whiskey. But after about two or three times like that, he looks around and finally he sees something and says, hey, how about giving her a drink? So she's standing there having a drink with him . In no time, he's buying seven drinks and buying me one which is going down the drain. Everybody. He's drinking the best. And the next thing you…
